build_glm_asr_model: build a GLM-ASR conditional generation model with audio encoder and Llama language model
create_audio_features: create audio embeddings from multimodal data items using the audio tower and multi-modal projector
test_glm_asr_forward: test the forward pass of GLM-ASR model with input ids, positions, and forward batch
load_glm_asr_weights: load HuggingFace compatible weights into GLM-ASR model with stacked parameter sharding support
pad_glm_asr_input_ids: pad input ids with multimodal token positions for audio-text sequence alignment
